pages: IN THE COURT OF THE ADDITIONAL DISTRICT JUDGE, SADAR. Civil Appeal No. 52 of 2022. Mahesh Yadav, appellant, versus Geeta Yadav, respondent. 1. This appeal arises from the judgment of the trial court dated 18 February 2022 in Original Suit No. 301 of 2018. 2. The appellant claims ownership of the plot bearing Khasra No. 412, village Nandpur, measuring 0.45 hectare. 3. The respondent is the appellant's sister-in-law.

4. The appellant produced a registered sale deed dated 9 August 2005 executed by Hari Prasad for a consideration of Rs. 3,20,000. 5. The appellant also produced khatauni entries for the years 2006 to 2016 showing his name as cultivator. 6. Two witnesses, PW-1 Dinesh and PW-2 Lakhan, proved the execution of the sale deed. 7. The land revenue receipts of 2012 and 2014 were marked as Exhibits A-3 and A-4.

8. The respondent relied on a registered will dated 22 April 2001 of her late father-in-law Ram Avtar. 9. DW-1, the respondent, admitted that the will was never probated. 10. DW-2, the village lekhpal, stated that the khatauni entries after 2006 stand in the name of the appellant. 11. The respondent paid a house tax of Rs. 1,150 in 2019, which relates to the residential house and not to the plot in dispute.

12. The trial court held that the will dated 22 April 2001 was proved. 13. This Court finds that the attesting witness to the will was not examined, and the will was therefore not proved under Section 68 of the Indian Evidence Act. 14. The sale deed dated 9 August 2005 is a registered document and the presumption of correctness applies. 15. The appellant's possession since 2005 is established by the khatauni entries.

16. The appeal is allowed. The judgment dated 18 February 2022 is set aside. 17. The suit of the respondent is dismissed with costs of Rs. 15,000. 18. The respondent shall not interfere with the appellant's possession. 19. Order pronounced on 27 September 2023. 20. The appeal was admitted on 4 May 2022, arguments were concluded on 11 July 2023 and judgment was reserved on that date.
